body.name: Expanded-state transport network
body.construction: Use arm states \(\mathcal E=\{0^{\star}\}\cup\{(d,y):d=1,\ldots,L,\ y\in\{0,1\}\}\), connect a left state at layer \(i\) to a right state at layer \(j\) exactly when \(i\le j\), assign the observed arm-cell probabilities as margins, and label a diagonal arc by stayer cost \(\sigma=1\) and by harm cost \(\eta=1\) exactly for \((d,1)\to(d,0)\)
